newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Uniwide says '96 net seen at 760 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Uniwide says '96 net seen at 760 mln pesos.

text.p: Retailer Uniwide Holdings Inc's 1996 net profits may likely hit 760 million pesos against an earlier forecast of 731 million pesos, the firm's chief financial officer Jaime Cabangis told Reuters on Monday.
Cabangis said the firm expects its bottom line earnings in 1997 to grow by 25 to 30 percent from the 1996 level.
The firm posted a net income of 111.6 million pesos in 1995.
